messages.author: 2cc2c22c61b42530
messages.subject: No Data When Downloading Files
parts:
My app works great on shinyapps.io but once uploaded to our company server the download function no longer works. At first we had issues with the write permissions as the app wasn't able to write a .png or .xlsx to the server but now we have changed this and the server responds with "no data received" but writes nothing to the error log. Then the app exits unexpectedly and says:

re-encoding from CP1252 Execution halted


Any ideas / pointers would be great!

Many Thanks
